title: Core: snap-to-objects position helper
description: Implement snap-to-objects helper in packages/core/src/engine/snap.ts. Function: snapPosition(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, frameIdx, movingObjId, proposedX, proposedY, threshold): {x, y, snapped}. Finds the nearest edge/center of other objects within threshold pixels and snaps to it. Supports: left/right/top/bottom edge alignment, center alignment. Returns the snapped position and whether snap occurred. Add unit tests.
